verdict.rationale: GitCafe's own stack tooling acts on many pull requests at once. `cafe stack submit` opens or reuses one PR per commit in a single command, and Land, Restack, Unstack and Close stack operate on a whole stack. GitHub import also brings over issues, PRs, reviews and comments in bulk. Beyond these, the evidence shows only scripting building blocks (`--json`, `--yes`, `cafe api`, REST API), which earn no credit on their own. missing for 10: general bulk actions on issues/PRs (e.g., mass label, close or assign), batch API endpoints, bulk operations through MCP or CLI outside stacks, independent or hands-on corroboration.
